mechanism: Senna-induced diarrhea and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium) may precipitate or exacerbate QT prolongation risk associated with haloperidol, and reduced GI absorption may decrease haloperidol bioavailability.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, assess QTc interval if senna use is necessary, and consider alternative laxatives; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if both drugs are used concurrently.
